notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands.
description:
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning a land to your hand, returning Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning a land to your hand, returning Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two land cards from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.
